fields.company_description: EcoPack Thailand develops biodegradable packaging solutions made from agricultural waste. Our mission is to replace single-use plastics with sustainable alternatives that decompose naturally.
fields.solution_description: We create compostable packaging from rice husks and corn starch that performs as well as traditional plastics but breaks down completely in 90 days.
fields.problem_statement: Traditional plastic packaging takes hundreds of years to decompose, contributing to environmental pollution and harming marine ecosystems.
fields.target_markets: Food and beverage industry, e-commerce retailers, restaurant chains across Southeast Asia
fields.funding_history: Received $150K seed funding from local angel investors in 2022
fields.use_of_funds: Product development, manufacturing scale-up, and market expansion
fields.financial_projections: Projecting $1.2M revenue by end of 2025 with 40% gross margins
fields.team_overview: Our team combines expertise in materials science, environmental engineering, and business development.
fields.core_expertise: Biodegradable materials research, sustainable manufacturing processes, B2B sales
fields.support_details: Looking for manufacturing partners, distribution channels, and Series A funding.
fields.additional_info: Our products are certified compostable and meet international food safety standards.

fields.company_description: PlasticFree Solutions is a B2B platform connecting businesses with sustainable packaging alternatives. We help companies transition from plastic to eco-friendly materials.
fields.solution_description: Our platform provides end-to-end sustainable packaging solutions including material sourcing, supplier verification, and impact tracking.
fields.problem_statement: Businesses struggle to find reliable, cost-effective sustainable packaging alternatives and lack visibility into their environmental impact.
fields.target_markets: FMCG companies, e-commerce platforms, food delivery services across ASEAN
fields.funding_history: Series A: $3M from Temasek Holdings and Wavemaker Partners in 2023
fields.use_of_funds: Regional expansion, technology development, team scaling
fields.financial_projections: Targeting $8M ARR by 2026 with expansion to 5 ASEAN countries
fields.team_overview: Team of ex-consultants, sustainability experts, and tech professionals from Google, Grab, and McKinsey.
fields.core_expertise: B2B sales, supply chain management, sustainability consulting, platform development
fields.support_details: Seeking Series B funding for regional expansion and partnerships with multinational corporations.
fields.additional_info: We have processed over $50M in sustainable packaging transactions and saved 2M kg of plastic waste.

fields.company_description: OceanClean develops autonomous marine robots that collect plastic waste from rivers and coastal areas before it reaches the ocean.
fields.solution_description: Our solar-powered robots use AI and computer vision to identify and collect plastic waste, with real-time monitoring and data analytics.
fields.problem_statement: 8 million tons of plastic enter our oceans annually, with 80% coming from rivers. Current collection methods are inefficient and costly.
fields.target_markets: Government agencies, environmental NGOs, corporate sustainability programs in Southeast Asia
fields.use_of_funds: Product development, field testing, team expansion
fields.financial_projections: Targeting $500K revenue in 2025 with 10 deployed units
fields.team_overview: Team combines marine biology expertise, robotics engineering, and environmental science.
fields.core_expertise: Marine robotics, AI/computer vision, environmental monitoring, sustainability
fields.support_details: Need funding for prototype development and seeking regulatory guidance for marine operations.
fields.additional_info: Our prototype has successfully collected 500kg of plastic waste in trials along Jakarta rivers.

fields.company_description: CircularPack operates a comprehensive plastic waste recycling and remanufacturing system, turning post-consumer plastic into high-quality packaging materials.
fields.solution_description: We use advanced chemical recycling to break down plastic waste into virgin-quality materials, with blockchain tracking for full traceability.
fields.problem_statement: Only 9% of plastic waste is effectively recycled. Most recycling processes degrade material quality, limiting reuse applications.
fields.target_markets: Packaging manufacturers, consumer goods companies, government waste management agencies across ASEAN
fields.funding_history: Series B: $12M from Khazanah Nasional and regional VCs in 2022
fields.use_of_funds: Facility expansion, technology R&D, regional market entry
fields.financial_projections: Projecting $25M revenue by 2026 with facilities in 3 countries
fields.core_team_size: 35 people across ops, R&D, business dev
fields.team_overview: Experienced team from P&G, Unilever, and leading chemical companies with deep packaging industry knowledge.
fields.core_expertise: Chemical recycling technology, polymer science, B2B sales, operations management
fields.support_details: Looking for strategic partnerships with multinational corporations and government agencies for expansion.
fields.additional_info: We process 50,000 tons of plastic waste annually and have achieved 95% material recovery rate.

fields.company_description: GreenTech develops enzyme-based biodegradation technology that accelerates the breakdown of plastic waste in natural environments.
fields.solution_description: Our proprietary enzyme formulations can break down PET plastics 6x faster than natural processes, with applications in waste treatment facilities.
fields.problem_statement: Plastic waste accumulation outpaces natural degradation by thousands of years, creating persistent environmental pollution.
fields.target_markets: Waste management companies, municipal governments, industrial manufacturers across Asia-Pacific
fields.funding_history: Pre-seed: $200K from Philippine angel investors and DOST-SETUP
fields.use_of_funds: R&D, clinical trials, regulatory approval, market validation
fields.financial_projections: Targeting $2M revenue by 2026 with commercial scale deployment
fields.team_overview: PhD-level scientists in biochemistry and environmental engineering with corporate R&D experience.
fields.core_expertise: Enzyme engineering, biochemical processes, environmental science, regulatory affairs
fields.support_details: Seeking Series A funding and partnerships with waste management companies for commercial trials.
fields.additional_info: Our enzyme treatment can process 10 tons of plastic waste per day with 80% degradation efficiency.

fields.company_description: SEA Seed Ventures is a leading early-stage VC fund focused on sustainability and climate technology startups across Southeast Asia.
fields.investment_philosophy: We invest in early-stage startups that are solving critical environmental challenges with scalable technology solutions. Our focus is on companies that can achieve both significant environmental impact and strong financial returns.
fields.support_details: We provide hands-on support including business development, strategic partnerships, follow-on funding, and access to our extensive network of corporates and government agencies.
fields.additional_info: Portfolio includes 45 companies across cleantech, circular economy, and sustainable agriculture with total portfolio value of $500M.

fields.company_description: Green Impact Fund is an impact investment fund dedicated to environmental sustainability and circular economy solutions in Southeast Asia.
fields.investment_philosophy: We target companies that deliver measurable environmental impact alongside financial returns. Focus on waste management, circular economy, and sustainable packaging solutions with proven business models.
fields.support_details: Beyond capital, we provide regulatory guidance, supply chain optimization, impact measurement frameworks, and connections to government and development agencies.
fields.additional_info: Our portfolio has diverted 2M tons of waste from landfills and created 5,000+ green jobs across the region.

fields.company_description: Asia Climate Capital is a growth-stage venture capital firm investing in climate technology and sustainability solutions across Asia-Pacific.
fields.investment_philosophy: We focus on scalable climate solutions with strong unit economics and clear paths to profitability. Target companies addressing large market opportunities with defensible technology moats.
fields.support_details: We offer growth capital, strategic advisory, business development support, and access to corporate partnerships for scaling operations across Asia.
fields.additional_info: Fund III is $400M focused on Series A-C companies. Portfolio companies have raised $2B+ in follow-on funding.

fields.company_description: Circular Ventures Asia specializes in early to growth-stage investments in circular economy and waste-to-value technologies across ASEAN.
fields.investment_philosophy: We invest in companies creating economic value from waste streams and driving transition to circular business models. Focus on proven technologies with clear commercial viability.
fields.support_details: We provide capital, market access, technology partnerships, and operational expertise to help portfolio companies scale across multiple markets.
fields.additional_info: Portfolio includes 28 companies processing 500K+ tons of waste annually with combined revenue of $150M.

fields.company_description: Pacific Green Partners is an angel investor network focused on early-stage environmental technology startups in the Philippines and broader Southeast Asia.
fields.investment_philosophy: We support passionate entrepreneurs solving environmental challenges with innovative approaches. Emphasis on strong founding teams and clear problem-solution fit.
fields.support_details: We offer seed capital, mentorship, network access, and ongoing strategic guidance for early-stage environmental technology companies.
fields.additional_info: Network of 50+ angel investors with combined investments of $25M in 80+ environmental startups across the region.

fields.company_description: Unilever is a leading multinational consumer goods company committed to sustainable living and reducing environmental footprint across all operations.
fields.support_details: We offer corporate venture capital, strategic partnerships, pilot opportunities, supply chain integration, and market access across our global distribution network.
fields.additional_info: Committed to making all plastic packaging reusable, recyclable, or compostable by 2025. Annual revenue of $60B+ globally with strong presence across ASEAN.

fields.company_description: Nestlé is the world's largest food and beverage company, committed to enhancing quality of life and contributing to a healthier future through sustainable packaging solutions.
fields.support_details: We provide corporate partnerships, R&D collaboration, manufacturing capabilities, regulatory expertise, and access to our extensive supply chain network.
fields.additional_info: Investing $2B globally to shift from virgin plastics to recycled materials. Goal to achieve 100% recyclable or reusable packaging by 2025.

fields.company_description: SCG is a leading industrial conglomerate in ASEAN, focusing on sustainable materials, chemicals, and packaging solutions for the circular economy.
fields.support_details: We offer manufacturing partnerships, material science R&D, scale-up facilities, distribution networks, and corporate venture investments.
fields.additional_info: Revenue of $13B+ with operations across ASEAN. Committed to carbon neutrality by 2050 and leading circular economy initiatives.

fields.company_description: Grab is Southeast Asia's leading super-app, committed to sustainable transportation and reducing environmental impact through technology and partnerships.
fields.support_details: We provide market access through our platform, brand partnership opportunities, corporate venture investments, and distribution channel access.
fields.additional_info: Platform connects 187M+ users with 5M+ driver-partners. Committed to net-zero emissions by 2040 and sustainable packaging for food delivery.

fields.company_description: CP Group is one of Asia's largest conglomerates with businesses spanning agribusiness, food, retail, and telecommunications, committed to sustainable development.
fields.support_details: We provide strategic investments, manufacturing capabilities, supply chain integration, market access across 20+ countries, and R&D collaboration.
fields.additional_info: Revenue of $65B+ with 400,000+ employees globally. Committed to sustainable agriculture and circular economy across food value chain.
